title: The Events map opens with its pins ready: a hover, focus or touch starts the read

source.ref: Signed-in production check 2026-11-17 after PERF-006: the first map open showed 'Finding events on the map' for about 3 s

detail: PERF-006 took the map rows out of the /events HTML (594 to 443 KB signed in) and reads them when the lightbox opens, so the first open waited on that server read. The map tile and the Map button now fire a warm event on pointer enter, focus and touch start; the lightbox starts its read then, under ADR-1974 (content behind a tap loads on that tap, started at the first sign of intent).

verify.note: Fails on main: the lightbox reads only on open. Passes once both map doors warm the read on intent.
